title: 才 vs 就 Step 3 · How Much? 才十岁, 三岁就会了
description: With amounts: 才 + number = only (so few, so young); number + 就 = already that much (so early). And spoken 就 + number = just.

points.title: 才 + number = only (so little / so young)
points.summary: 才 right before a number: the speaker finds it small.
points.body:
- 他**才**十岁。 He's only ten.
- 这件衣服**才**五十块！ Only 50 kuai!
- 我**才**吃了一个。 I've only eaten one.

**才 vs 就 at a glance**

| | 就 🐇 | 才 🐢 |
|---|---|---|
| time | earlier than expected: 六点**就**来了 | later than expected: 十点**才**来 |
| 了? | usually **with** 了 | **no** 了 at the end |
| amount | 三岁**就**会游泳了 (that young!) | **才**十岁 (only ten) |
| condition | **只要**…**就**… (as long as) | **只有**…**才**… (only if) |
| also | **一**…**就**… (as soon as) | **才** = only just: 我才知道 |

**Feel the speaker:** 就 = sooner, easier, already 🐇 · 才 = later, harder, only then 🐢
examples: He's only ten and already at university!

points.title: Number + 就 = already that much / that early
points.summary: A number before 就: it happened at an early point or with little effort.
points.body:
- 他三岁**就**会写字了。 He could write at three.
- 我一个人**就**吃了三碗。 I ate three bowls all by myself.
- Spoken: **就** + number = only, just: 我**就**一个朋友。 (I've only got one friend.)

**才 vs 就 at a glance**

| | 就 🐇 | 才 🐢 |
|---|---|---|
| time | earlier than expected: 六点**就**来了 | later than expected: 十点**才**来 |
| 了? | usually **with** 了 | **no** 了 at the end |
| amount | 三岁**就**会游泳了 (that young!) | **才**十岁 (only ten) |
| condition | **只要**…**就**… (as long as) | **只有**…**才**… (only if) |
| also | **一**…**就**… (as soon as) | **才** = only just: 我才知道 |

**Feel the speaker:** 就 = sooner, easier, already 🐇 · 才 = later, harder, only then 🐢
examples: He could write when he was three.

questions.prompt: What does 「{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{衣服|yīfu}{才|cái}{五十|wǔshí}{块|kuài}。」 mean?
options: This didn't cost 50 kuai until later.
notes: 才 shows the speaker finds it cheap.

questions.prompt: {他|tā}（　）{十二|shí'èr}{岁|suì}，{个子|gèzi}{已经|yǐjīng}{比|bǐ}{爸爸|bàba}{高|gāo}{了|le}。
notes: 都十二岁了 = 'already 12' — the opposite feeling.
就十二岁 is possible in speech, but 才 is the natural 'only' here.
questions.translation: He's only twelve, and already taller than his dad.

notes: 才 = not until two (late) — and doesn't take 了.
questions.translation: My son could talk at two.

questions.prompt:
A：{你|nǐ}{吃|chī}{饱|bǎo}{了|le}{吗|ma}？
B：{没有|méiyǒu}，{我|wǒ}（　）{吃|chī}{了|le}{一个|yí ge}{包子|bāozi}。
notes: 终于 = finally — doesn't fit 'not full'.
已经 = already — the opposite feeling.
questions.translation: A: Are you full? B: No — I've only had one bun.

questions.prompt: What does 「{他|tā}{一个人|yí ge rén}{就|jiù}{吃|chī}{了|le}{三|sān}{碗|wǎn}。」 mean?
options: He ate three bowls all by himself.
He didn't eat until there were three bowls.
notes: 就 here stresses how much one person ate.
一个人 = by himself — not one bowl.
questions.translation: He ate three bowls all by himself.

questions.prompt: Which sentence says the speaker thinks 100 kuai is **cheap**?
'I've only got one brother.' (spoken) Which fits?
Build it: 'It's only seven — how come you're going to bed already?'
questions.explanation: 现在**才**七点，你怎么**就**要睡了？ 才 + number = only that much; 就 = already, too soon.
questions.translation: It's only seven — how come you're going to bed already?

questions.prompt: 「{他|tā}{十|shí}{岁|suì}{才|cái}{会|huì}{游泳|yóuyǒng}。」 vs 「{他|tā}{十|shí}{岁|suì}{就|jiù}{会|huì}{开车|kāichē}{了|le}。」
options: First: ten is late for swimming. Second: ten is amazingly early for driving.
questions.explanation: 才 = later than expected; 就 = earlier than expected.
才 + number takes **no 了**: 他才十岁.
